summary.text: Dianne Norris is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
According to Ballotpedia, she is an engineer who earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska in 2012.

paragraphs.text: Norris said in a Ballotpedia survey that she lives with her husband in Cooperstown and was raised outside a midwestern farming community.
She said she graduated from the University of Nebraska in engineering and went on to work in manufacturing.
Norris said she would work to provide funding for free school meals if voters decide it is a worthy cause, and that she supports local public schools and libraries as investments in the future.
She said her policy passion is building a transparent, accessible and effective government.
